userStories.title: Compute tilt_y from acceleration (pitch angle)
userStories.description: Calculate tilt angle around Y axis using atan2
userStories.diff:
float tilt_x = atan2(...);
+ float tilt_y = atan2(-accel_event.acceleration.x, sqrt(accel_event.acceleration.y * accel_event.acceleration.y + accel_event.acceleration.z * accel_event.acceleration.z)) * 180.0 / PI;

userStories.title: Server: Parse gyro_z from puck_input WebSocket event
userStories.description: Extract gyro_z field from incoming puck data for spin detection
userStories.diff:
@socketio.on('puck_input')
def handle_puck_input(data):
   puck_id = data.get('puck_id')
   tilt_x = data.get('tilt_x', 0)
   tilt_y = data.get('tilt_y', 0)
+  gyro_z = data.get('gyro_z', 0)
+  spin_speed = data.get('spin_speed', 0)
+  shake_intensity = data.get('shake_intensity', 0)
+  shake_detected = data.get('shake_detected', False)
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs show gyro_z when puck sends data
userStories.notes: Added handle_puck_input WebSocket handler at line 647
